|lead='''Don't Get Cocky''' is a [[Light]] [[Lost Interrupt]] released as a super-rare diffraction foil in [[Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy|Reflections II]]. It reprints the [[Premiere]] card.<ref name="check">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/reflections2/reflections2cardlist.pdf Reflections II collector’s card list], Decipher, Light Side diffraction-foil cards: Don’t Get Cocky, Premiere, SRF. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20080509122433/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/reflections2/reflections2cardlist.pdf Internet Archive].</ref> It was released on 10 January 2001.<ref name="release">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], Reflections II product entry (collecting reference). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
|lore=Luke and Han made an effective team when defending the ''Millennium Falcon'' with its quad laser cannons against attacking TIE fighters. "Great kid! Don't get cocky."
|game_text=If Luke and Han are in a battle together, you may add two battle destiny. OR If the opponent just initiated a battle at a system or sector, choose one TIE/ln present to be lost.
|errata_history=The foil's second function says “at a system or sector, choose one TIE/ln present to be lost”, rather than “at any system, destroy (lose) one TIE Fighter of your choice at that system” on [[Don't Get Cocky|Premiere Limited]]. The photographed foil has its own printed wording; [[Don't Get Cocky (Errata)|the errata article]] remains separately available.<ref name="faces">Printed faces: [[:File:Reflections-II-L-Dont-Get-Cocky-Foil-PSA.jpg|Reflections II foil]] and [[:File:Premiere-L-dontgetcocky-decipher-archive.gif|Premiere Limited]].</ref>
